baseline_models.focus_anchor: تَذْكِرَةٌ ... شَاءَ ٱتَّخَذَ ... إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا
baseline_models.mechanism: The reminder restores an absent matter to presence; willing turns that presence into adoption of a conduct, and the extended road directs that conduct toward the Lord who nurtures and completes.

activation_trace.role: A reminder makes a matter present again and initiates the movement from recollection to response.
Will directed toward a thing supplies the chooser's intentional orientation.
Taking on a conduct or form makes the response an adopted manner of life.
Nurturing, repair, and stagewise completion make the destination formative rather than merely locative.
An extended traversable route supplies the sustained means by which the chosen conduct reaches its end.

changed_reading.before: The ayah offers optional spiritual advice and a generic road to God.
changed_reading.after: The ayah describes a recalled truth becoming a voluntarily adopted, sustained course of formation toward one's nurturing Lord.

baseline_models.mechanism: Recall can renew the felt presence of its object, while the will-root can image the self as drawn or delighted by something; path-taking can therefore be affective attraction converted into deliberate acquisition of a means.

activation_trace.role: Bringing a retained or forgotten matter back to mind gives desire an object held in present awareness.
The image of a self drawn to or delighted by a thing gives willing an affective pull.
Adopting or acquiring something turns attraction into a possessed practical means.
The road gives attraction a direction and a course that can actually be followed.

changed_reading.before: Whoever wills makes a detached intellectual decision.
changed_reading.after: The reminder can reawaken attraction to its object, and path-taking is the practical conversion of that attraction into direction.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening's human who was not yet a knowable, mentionable thing is answered by the closing 'this is a reminder': the discourse recalls the human and gives that human a present, addressable standing from which willing can occur.

activation_trace.role: The focus reminder makes an absent matter present and addressable again.
The knowable thing supplies the opening's negated threshold of reportable existence.
Mention on the tongue makes explicit the initial absence of voiced or public presence that the reminder reverses.

structural_cues: 76:1 negates the human's prior status as a mentioned thing, while 76:29 demonstratively names the present discourse a reminder near the surah's close.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the opening negation and closing reminder; I infer that the closure recapitulates emergence by making the addressee present to mind and speech. A live alternative is a simple verbal callback with no claim that addressability itself is being remade.

changed_reading.before: The reminder addresses an already stable chooser.
changed_reading.after: The reminder participates in the surah's movement from an unmentioned human to a remembered and addressable chooser.

context_deltas.mechanism: Creation equips hearing and inward sight for a test, then gentle guidance points to the road; the focus act of taking a way is therefore observable uptake of a route already disclosed to a fitted but tested agent.

activation_trace.role: Directed willing supplies the agent's responsive intention within the test.
Taking on a conduct renders guidance as lived uptake rather than bare exposure.
The traversable route anchors the focus action to the earlier guided road.
Testing that makes a condition appear turns response to the reminder into disclosure of the agent's state.
Hearing as understanding and compliance supplies a receptive capacity whose use can be tested.
Inward discernment supplies the complementary capacity to recognize the offered route.
Gentle indication toward road and truth establishes guidance as prior to human uptake.
The earlier definite traversable road supplies the route that the focus chooser can later take as a way.

structural_cues: 76:2 places testing before the making of hearing and sight; 76:3 then uses the definite path, while 76:29 shifts to an indefinite way with the human as taker.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fitted faculties, testing, prior guidance, and the repeated road root; I infer that taking the way is the test's manifested uptake rather than route invention. The live alternative is that 76:3 states general guidance while 76:29 permits any responsive means without a direct definite-to-indefinite link.

changed_reading.before: The chooser originates a route after receiving optional advice.
changed_reading.after: A perceptually equipped, tested agent reveals a disposition by taking up a road that divine guidance has already indicated.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated causative descent and delivery, joined to recitation, gives the demonstrative 'this' a material-discursive antecedent: the reminder is encountered as the delivered and recited Qur'an rather than as an unspecified maxim.

activation_trace.role: The reminder names the focus discourse by its capacity to restore matters to awareness.
Causing something to descend and reach its recipient supplies the reminder's delivered form.
Reading and recitation make the delivered reminder repeatably voiced and received.

structural_cues: 76:23 emphatically names the Qur'an and repeats the descent verb through a verbal noun only six ayat before the demonstrative in 76:29.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a nearby emphatic delivery statement and the later demonstrative; I infer that the Qur'an is the demonstrative's salient vehicle. A live alternative is that 'this' gathers the whole reward-warning sequence, not only the named recitation.

changed_reading.before: This is a generic reminder whose medium is left open.
changed_reading.after: This is a reminder arriving through a specifically delivered, recitable discourse that can repeatedly reactivate its hearer.

context_deltas.mechanism: The road is enacted by coordinated forms of movement: sustenance goes outward to others, action faces God rather than repayment, the self is restrained under pressure, effort advances toward its object, remembered speech recurs, and the body lowers in worship. These social, volitional, verbal, and bodily acts are the mechanics of a lived route.

activation_trace.role: Taking on a conduct lets the path consist in patterned action rather than abstract assent.
The traversable means gathers dispersed practices into one directed course.
Mention on the tongue turns remembrance into a recurring voiced practice.
Giving food to another supplies the route's outward transfer of sustenance.
Direction and orientation make God's face the governing vector of the deed.
Restraining the self from panic supplies the route's capacity to persist under pressure.
Purposeful motion toward a sought object explicitly casts their effort as directed advance.
Bodily lowering supplies a concrete posture through which the adopted way is enacted.
Praise and prayer extend the route into sustained nocturnal worship.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from vow and feeding in 76:7-9, through recognized effort in 76:22, to patience, remembrance, prostration, and praise in 76:24-26 immediately before the focus invitation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated practices and the focus road metaphor; I infer that outward service, restraint, speech, and posture function as steps or means of that road. A live alternative is that they portray exemplary travelers without exhaustively defining the path.

changed_reading.before: Taking a way is an unspecified inward commitment.
changed_reading.after: Taking a way is adopting a coordinated social and ritual discipline whose acts repeatedly orient and move the self toward the Lord.

context_deltas.mechanism: The will of the focus is not neutral preference: it follows people whose hearts adhere to the immediate and who actively leave a weighty future behind their backs. The reminder contests that nearward pull by returning the displaced future to awareness and redirecting desire toward the Lord.

activation_trace.role: Recall restores to present awareness what temporal preference has pushed out of view.
Affective attraction in the will-root makes the focus choice a redirection of desire, not only calculation.
Love adhering to the heart supplies the competing attachment that structures the chooser's will.
Haste and bringing forward give the loved object its temporal nearness.
Leaving a thing supplies the active abandonment opposed to taking a way.
Placing something behind the back supplies the spatial concealment of the deferred consequence.
Weight opposed to lightness gives the displaced future the burden that immediate desire avoids.

structural_cues: 76:27 immediately precedes the focus and opposes loving the immediate to leaving a heavy day behind; 76:29 then opens an alternative with 'so whoever wills.'
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a temporal-spatial desire pattern and the focus invitation; I infer that the reminder reverses the act of putting the future behind and thereby reorients willing. A live alternative is that 76:27 describes only one rejecting group and does not characterize every chooser's psychology.

changed_reading.before: Willing is an unpressured choice among abstract options.
changed_reading.after: Willing is a struggle over temporal orientation: the reminder makes a discarded future present so desire can turn from the immediate toward the Lord.

context_deltas.mechanism: The chooser is a made and bodily fastened agent whose counterpart can be substituted at divine willing. Path-taking remains a real human act, but its actor, coherence, and continued place are received and contingent rather than self-grounding.

activation_trace.role: Human willing supplies the focus act whose creaturely conditions are exposed by the preceding ayah.
Taking hold anchors agency as a genuine act performed by the constituted human.
Divine willing toward an outcome places the agent's continuity under a prior will.
Bringing the creature into being supplies the chooser's received origin.
The cohesion of bodily joints supplies the concrete constitution through which choice is enacted.
Tightening a bond makes bodily coherence an effected fastening rather than an autonomous possession.
One thing standing in another's place supplies the chooser's replaceability.
A counterpart or likeness supplies the possible substitute for the present agent.

structural_cues: 76:28 is immediately adjacent and surrounds its conditional divine willing with first-person creation, fastening, and substitution before 76:29 shifts to human willing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies made bodily cohesion, possible replacement, and adjacent human willing; I infer a dependence relation between constituted capacity and path-taking. A live alternative is to read 76:28 only as a threat of replacement, without extending it into an account of creaturely agency.

changed_reading.before: A self-standing chooser independently takes possession of a path.
changed_reading.after: A genuinely acting but created, bodily constituted, and replaceable chooser takes the path through capacities that are not self-grounded.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same will-root is repeated for human and divine willing under an exception, then joined to complete knowing and right judgment. Human uptake is not erased, but its efficacy is nested within informed and wise divine willing.

activation_trace.role: Will directed toward a thing supplies the human intention asserted in the invitation.
Lordship and sovereignty make the destination also the governing source within which the approach occurs.
The repeated image of will toward a thing maps both human willing and the divine willing on which it is explicitly conditioned.
Wisdom as accurate knowledge and judgment qualifies the encompassing will as purposive rather than arbitrary.
A thing disclosed to the knower supplies the complete awareness accompanying divine willing.

structural_cues: 76:30 immediately answers 'whoever wills' with 'you do not will unless God wills' and then predicates knowledge and wisdom.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet explicitly supplies the exception and repeated will-root; I infer that the condition governs the efficacy and possibility of human uptake while leaving the imperative grammar meaningful. A live alternative is to stress either permission or determination more exclusively than this dependent-agency model does.

changed_reading.before: Human willing independently activates the journey toward the Lord.
changed_reading.after: Human willing is a meaningful but dependent uptake whose possibility and efficacy remain within the Lord's knowing and wise willing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The human takes a way, but God causes whomever God wills to cross into mercy. The path therefore has asymmetric agency: the traveler adopts an approach, while arrival is reception across a threshold rather than self-entry.

activation_trace.role: Adopting or acquiring a way supplies the traveler's real responsive act.
The nurturing Lord supplies the relational destination whose mercy receives the traveler.
The route supplies approach toward a destination without itself guaranteeing entry.
Divine willing toward the entrant supplies the selection governing the final transition.
Caused passage into an interior supplies the threshold-crossing that completes, but differs from, taking a route.
Mercy and tenderness specify the receptive sphere into which entry is granted.

structural_cues: 76:29 uses human agency for taking a way; after 76:30 conditions willing, 76:31 switches to divine causative agency for entry into mercy.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies route-taking followed by caused entry; I infer an approach-threshold sequence in which the second act cannot be collapsed into the first. A live alternative is that mercy names the route's result without carrying a materially spatial threshold image.

changed_reading.before: The chooser reaches the Lord simply by taking and traversing a path.
changed_reading.after: The chooser adopts the approach, but consummation is the Lord's act of admitting the traveler into mercy.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the rights-document branch of ذ ك ر is specialized and distant from the ordinary noun تذكرة; it remains anchored through the focus cluster of reminder, acquisition, lordship, covenant, and route. Downstream prose should present it only as a legal analogy for actionable commitment, not as the lexical sense demanded by the ayah.

activation_trace.role: A document recording a right supplies the reminder with the exploratory image of an actionable instrument.
Adopting or acquiring supplies the act by which the instrument's offered route is taken up.
A pact or protection covenant supplies a relational framework under the Lord.
The road as a means supplies what the covenantal instrument authorizes the chooser to undertake.

changed_reading.before: The reminder is admonition that asks for assent.
changed_reading.after: As a contained legal analogy, the reminder resembles an offered instrument of right or covenant whose route becomes operative when the chooser takes it up.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the moon's taking of stations is a specialized branch of ء خ ذ and need not color the focus verb; it remains anchored in the exact taking construction, the road, and the surah's morning-evening-night rhythm. Downstream prose should mark it as a temporal itinerary analogy, never as a claim that the ayah prescribes lunar ritual.

activation_trace.role: Repeated recall supplies the return of orientation at each temporal station.
The moon taking up successive stations night by night supplies an iterative model of path-taking.
Abiding, persistence, and drawing near make repeated station-taking cumulative rather than circular stasis.
The extended road organizes successive stations into one itinerary toward the Lord.
The beginning of day supplies the itinerary's recurring first boundary.
Evening time supplies the corresponding daily boundary for renewed remembrance.
Practicing an affair at night supplies the extended nocturnal interval through which stations are inhabited.

changed_reading.before: Taking a path is a single decisive choice.
changed_reading.after: As a contained temporal analogy, the choice becomes a station-by-station itinerary renewed across morning, evening, and night.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it links the womb branch of mercy to the Lord's nurture and the surah's mixed-drop creation, crossing biological and theological domains; it remains anchored in رَبِّهِ and the route's movement toward the mercy named in 76:31. Downstream prose must call it a generative or gestational analogy, not identify divine mercy with a literal womb or make a biological lexical claim about the focus ayah.

activation_trace.role: Stagewise nurture and completion supplies the focus destination with a developmental image.
The traversable way organizes development as movement toward completion.
Origination of the creature supplies the beginning of the generative arc.
The clear drop extending through the image of semen supplies the creature's small fluid origin.
Mixture and interpenetration supply the composite material from which maturation begins.
The womb image supplies an exploratory enclosing counterpart to mercy at the route's end.

changed_reading.before: The path runs from an autonomous adult toward an external sovereign.
changed_reading.after: As a contained gestational analogy, the mixed-origin creature follows a maturation route toward the Lord's completing nurture and enclosing mercy.

strongest_changes: The earlier guided road and testing faculties turn focus path-taking from route invention into manifested uptake of prior guidance.
The ethical and ritual sequences make the road a coordinated discipline of service, restraint, remembrance, and embodied worship.
76:27-30 turn willing from neutral preference into temporally contested, created, and divinely conditioned agency.
76:31 distinguishes human approach from final arrival: the chooser takes a way, while the Lord grants entry into mercy.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet exposed an opening-to-closing arc from being unmentioned to being reminded, and a route mechanism spanning creation, guidance, enacted practice, contested desire, dependent willing, and admitted arrival; it also preserved legal, temporal-station, and gestational analogies that a single consensus reading would likely flatten.
remaining_uncertainties: The demonstrative 'this' may point narrowly to the Qur'an in 76:23 or broadly to the surah's entire reward-warning sequence.
The exact force of the shift from the definite path in 76:3 to an indefinite way in 76:29 remains open.
The legal, lunar-station, and gestational models are branch-backed analogies, not secure lexical determinations.
76:30 clearly conditions human willing, but the packet alone does not settle whether the emphasis falls on permission, capacity, efficacy, or outcome.
